VIX dropped sharply to 14.17 (-6.78% 1d, -14.12% 1mo), a genuine calming signal, and S&P/Dow are modestly green. But Gold is still up +3.77% 1d (+10.63% 1mo) at $4,530.9 -- the safe-haven bid from yesterday has not unwound, which keeps the equity green from reading as full conviction risk-on. USD/PKR (277.21) and DXY (99.06) remain essentially flat, so the FX channel is still holding. BTC/ETH both up firmly (+4.4%/+4.9% 1d) is a soft risk-on cross-check.
